title.narrative: Regional TB in the Mining Sector initiative “Finding missing TB cases” - Africa - Multicountry Southern Africa WHC (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Multicountry Southern Africa WHC, Tuberculosis, Wits Health Consortium (Pty) Ltd (WHC)This program has the following goals: To contribute towards the reduction of the TB burden in the mining sector in Southern African countries. The objectives of this program are: To increase TB case finding among the key populations in the mining sector in Southern Africa. To increase the proportion of key populations on TB treatment that complete their treatment. To increase the proportion of key populations with TB that are tested for HIV and enrolled for ART
